dialogue.text: Hey kid, This is a nice place you got here.
To be honest, I’ve been kinda down on my luck recently. No work, no friends, no food...
I mean I’m even down to my last pack of cigs...
But from the looks of it, my luck’s turning around.
I'm assuming you know how things work around here?
Simple, you and I in a game of Menko, with our resources on the line.

options.text: Can't believe people actually do this

dialogue.text: Forget whatever you've seen about menko, I've got some cards that'll blow you away.
Get ready to part with your stuff kid, we're settling this at the table
